```plato

// Blue-noise scattering: an even, isotropic distribution with its energy
// concentrated in high frequencies and almost none near zero. Ideal for
// stippling, dithering, and sample-position tables
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colors_of_noise).
//
// Count is exact when the region can hold that many: generation picks the
// Poisson-disk radius that saturates at slightly more than Count points and
// then thins the result evenly back to Count. A region too small for Count
// points yields as many as fit.
type BlueNoisePattern2D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds2D;
    Count: Integer;
    Seed: Integer;
}
```
